features.text: CARBON FIBER CONSTRUCTION: Delivers lightweight, rigid support with dynamic energy return.
PDAC APPROVED L1932: Recognized for medical-grade performance in managing foot drop and contractures.
TRIMMABLE FOOTPLATE: Customizable to user-specific dimensions for precise, comfortable wear.
ENERGY-RETURN DESIGN: Stores and releases energy during stride for improved gait and endurance.
MULTI-CONDITION STABILITY: Supports stroke recovery, peroneal paralysis, and neuromuscular weakness.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
